answer_4.quote: 200 individuals were involved in the annotation process for the dataset. The annotators chosen had participated in at least one debate at a school or college level.
answer_4.guideline: Each annotator was asked two questions per argument-analysis pair. 1. Is the argument something you would recommend a friend use as-is in a speech supporting/opposing a topic, regardless of personal opinion? 2. Would you recommend a friend use the analysis to defend the argument as it is?
